subject: Pricing approval required — Mustang Labs pilot discount
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir@mustanglabs.com>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoood-inference.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@mustanglabs.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -04:00
Subject: Pilot pricing request — Mustang Labs

Karthik,

Thanks for the call earlier. Mustang is excited to run a 6-week pilot of the Redwood inference stack. Scope: 2 dedicated instances, up to 1M tokens/month, support during onboarding. We have budget constraints for pilots — procurement is asking if you can provide a 30% pilot discount on the quoted list price.

High level:
- Expected ARR if we expand post-pilot: $120k
- Pilot start target: July 5
- PO can be provided next week if pricing is agreed

Can you confirm whether your deal desk can approve 30% for the pilot, or what the maximum is? We need an answer by Wednesday 6/24 to keep the timeline. I attached the PO template and the summary of usage.

Best,
Samir Patel
Head of ML Platforms
Mustang Labs
Attachments: mustang_discount_request_0621.pdf

From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoood-inference.com>
To: rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoood-inference.com>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwoood-inference.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwoood-inference.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Pilot pricing request — Mustang Labs

Folks — forwarding Mustang's ask. Customer is requesting 30% off for a 6-week pilot but has clear expansion potential (approx $120k ARR). Timeline is tight (decision by 6/24).

My initial thoughts: 30% is aggressive for a pilot. Could we authorize up to 20% fast, with a playbook for granting more if they (a) sign a 12-month expansion commitment after pilot, or (b) agree to usage floors? Need a quick decision because this is a forecasted commit candidate for Q3 if they sign.

Please review the attached pricing_impact_summary_0621.xlsx and advise: 1) deal desk recommended discount cap, 2) required contract terms for increased discount, and 3) whether Finance needs to exclude this from committed forecast until PO + signature is in place.

Marissa — please confirm the customer's willingness to sign a 12-month expansion or a minimum usage floor if we move beyond 20%.

Thanks,
Karthik
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
Attachments: pricing_impact_summary_0621.xlsx

From: rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoood-inference.com>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoood-inference.com>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwoood-inference.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2026 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot pricing request — Mustang Labs

Karthik / Laura — reviewed Mustang's request and the impact sheet. Summary:
- 30% on list for pilot is outside typical delegated deal desk authority.
- Recommend an interim approval of 22% for the pilot if the customer signs a follow-on 12-month commitment within 30 days of pilot close, or
- Alternatively, 25% with a guaranteed minimum monthly spend (usage floor) of $6k for the pilot term.

Conditions for higher discount: legal redlines to include a performance SLA and early-expansion trigger. I attached the standard deal desk approval form and a suggested clause list for the expansion commitment.

If you want us to push to 30% we will need explicit Finance sign-off and a margin sketch from Laura.

Rishi
Senior Deal Desk Analyst
Redwood Inference
Attachments: dealdesk_approval_form_0622.pdf

On Mon, Jun 21, 2026 at 11:03 AM karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoood-inference.com> wrote:
> Folks — forwarding Mustang's ask. Customer is requesting 30% off for a 6-week pilot but has clear expansion potential (approx $120k ARR). Timeline is tight (decision by 6/24).

From: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwoood-inference.com>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoood-inference.com>, rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoood-inference.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwoood-inference.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot pricing request — Mustang Labs

Agree with Rishi's recommendations. A few Finance constraints and guidance for forecasting:
- Any discount >20% requires written Finance approval and needs to be logged in the approvals tracker (see HubSpot link below).
- We should NOT mark this as 'Committed' in the forecast until we have signed contract + PO on file. For now, categorize as "Best Case" with probability 40% in the Q3 pipeline. If we get a signed 12-month expansion or DocuSign within 30 days we can reclassify as Commit.
- If the team wants to pursue 25% or above we need a quick margin sketch (I ran a back-of-envelope; 25% would push gross margin under our target for this SKU unless we make the discount conditional on the expansion).

Action items:
1) Karthik/Marissa: update HubSpot opportunity with the new probability and attach the PO template. HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/67890
2) Rishi: prepare final approval form with recommended language for the expansion trigger and usage floor.
3) Sales: do not include this in the committed forecast column until signed.

I'll sign off on anything at 22% or below via email; anything >22% I'll need to escalate to FP&A.

Laura Bennett
Head of Finance, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoood-inference.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwoood-inference.com>, rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoood-inference.com>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwoood-inference.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2026 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot pricing request — Mustang Labs

Thanks — plan below and I'll execute:
- Offer 22% pilot discount conditioned on a signed 12-month expansion OR a $6k/month usage floor for the pilot term. Rishi to finalize approval form and clause; Marissa to confirm customer acceptance.
- Update HubSpot today to "Best Case" 40% probability and attach Mustang's PO template + dealdesk form. HubSpot link: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/67890
- Marissa, if the customer signs DocuSign for the expansion trigger, move the opp to "Commit - Pending Signatures" and notify Finance to re-evaluate probability. DocuSign envelope (expected): https://www.docusign.com/recipient/embedded?envelopeId=0a1b2c3d4e5f

I'll message the customer with this compromise after Rishi provides the final language.

Karthik
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
